lines: Mingo played 31% of snaps over his last 3 games, up from 24% for the season, but he is only getting 1.3 targets a game.

Dallas faces Philadelphia, which allows the 3rd-most PPR points per game to WRs, but the coach said Mingo would have a limited practice on Wednesday.
